title: FaZe Esports, a GameSquare Company, Wins Rainbow Six Championship at 2026 Esports World Cup
summary: FaZe Esports Earns $750,000 Championship Prize, Expected to Contribute to GameSquare's Third Quarter 2026 Revenue Latest Victory Follows Back-to-Back Six Invitational World Championships in 2025 and 2026 Win Adds 1,000 Club Championship Points as FaZe Esports Continues to Compete for Additional Esports World Cup Winnings FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / August 17, 2026 / GameSquare Holdings, Inc. ("GameSquare" or the "Company") (NASDAQ:GAME), today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, FaZe Esports, won the Rainbow Six championship at the 2026 Esports World Cup in Paris, France, earning $750,000 in prize winnings, which is expected to contribute to GameSquare's third quarter 2026 revenue. FaZe Esports defeated FURIA 3-1 in the Grand Final to capture the championship and earn 1,000 Esports World Cup Club Championship points. The victory extends an extraordinary run for FaZe Esports' Rainbow Six team, which has now captured the 2025 Six Invitational, 2026 Six Invitational and 2026
